subject.title: feat(ui): drag custom sidebar groups between built-in session zones

question: Should custom-group placement relative to built-in sidebar zones be a synchronized `ui.prefs` contract across Control UI browsers, rather than a browser-local layout choice?
rationale: The implementation is additive and follows the existing server-preference path, but it intentionally creates a new durable configuration behavior that affects cross-browser layout synchronization.

options.title: Adopt the synced preference
options.body: Keep the optional configuration preference and merge after the remaining failed CI lanes are resolved or demonstrated unrelated.

options.title: Keep placement browser-local
options.body: Rework the feature to store the section arrangement only in local UI settings, avoiding a server-synchronized configuration contract.

options.title: Pause the feature direction
options.body: Defer the new placement behavior until maintainers define the desired native-client and multi-browser layout semantics.

recommendation.title: Adopt the synced preference
recommendation.body: Keep the optional configuration preference and merge after the remaining failed CI lanes are resolved or demonstrated unrelated.

likelyOwner.reason: The assignee and current implementation author documented the intended ownership boundary and can clarify the desired preference contract.
